observation.visible_scene: A close-up, shallow-depth-of-field shot of a clear glass bowl filled with round lemon slices (yellow rind, pale segmented flesh) resting on a pinkish wooden surface. A thin stream of clear liquid pours from a grayish vessel visible at the top-right of the frame, falling onto the lemon slices and into the liquid already in the bowl. The bowl rim in the foreground is softly blurred; focus sits on the central lemon slice where the stream lands.
visible_changes: The pouring stream remains active throughout the excerpt; its falling column continuously deforms, narrowing, wavering, and breaking into droplets between frames.
The splash and ripple pattern on the upper lemon slice changes frame to frame as the stream strikes it, with scattered droplets and bright highlights appearing in different positions.
The gray pouring vessel at the top right shifts and tilts slightly relative to the frame, altering how much of its rim is visible and the angle from which the stream emerges.
The bowl and lemon slices stay essentially fixed in place; the visible motion is in the liquid (stream and splashes), not in the solid objects.
Minor handheld-style jitter is present, but the overall framing of the bowl stays consistent.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the pouring began before this excerpt or continues after it (both ends are arbitrary crop boundaries).
The identity of the pouring vessel and the exact liquid (appears clear like water but is not confirmed).
The final fill level of the bowl after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: Whether the water level inside the bowl rises noticeably over the excerpt is hard to confirm from the frames.
The precise nature of camera motion (slight drift vs. handheld shake) is uncertain given the static background.
Small apparent shifts in the lemon slices may be due to liquid movement or focus changes rather than true object translation.
